args.content:
Hawaii Packing List

Based on your Hawaii vacation itinerary (June 10-20, 2024), here's your complete packing list:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days, snorkeling, and kayaking)
- Sunscreen (high SPF for tropical sun protection)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head and other outdoor activities)
- Casual outfits (for shopping, dining, and relaxation)
- Camera (to capture memories of your Hawaiian adventure)
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, reservations)

Activity-Specific Items:
- Beach towel and beach bag
- Snorkeling gear (if you prefer your own)
- Hiking shoes or sturdy sandals
- Light jacket or sweater (for air-conditioned places and evening luaus)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Waterproof phone case
- Sunglasses and hat

Additional Toiletries and Personal Items:
- Insect repellent
- Aloe vera gel (in case of sunburn)
- Basic first aid kit
- Any necessary medications

Remember to pack light, as you'll have opportunities to do laundry if needed. Have a wonderful trip to Hawaii!
